Manto.FreeDisk — where did my disk space go?
================================================

Nothing to install: extract and run.

  mfd-cli.exe    the answer, read: the colored grid, -big 10, filters,
                 -json. English is embedded — it works alone.
  mfd-tui.exe    the answer, navigated: the two-panel navigator.

Want more? install.ps1 (same folder) publishes both as user commands
(%USERPROFILE%\.local\bin — make sure that folder is in your PATH) and
drops the other six languages in %APPDATA%\mfd\lang.

Verify the download: the .sha256 file that rides next to this ZIP.

License: AGPL-3.0 — see LICENSE. The full story (FAQ, architecture,
the experiment) lives in the docs/ folder of the repository.
